_comment: CIVILIAN kit: a faired TANK BLISTER - three stacked hull-coloured shells and two dark seam lines, nothing else. The salvage answer to this class is a lashed drum and the industrial one would be an open rack; a sold ship hides its tankage under a fairing and admits to it only at the panel seams, so the piece is deliberately ALL hull colour - no accent, no lamp. Long on Z and aligned to the run, so a row of them reads as one faired sponson down the hull rather than as cargo.
